summary.text:
• The Golden State Valkyries lead the Atlanta Dream 3-2 in the WNBA Finals heading into Game 6.
• The Rockets start 5-0 and look like West contenders, while the Lakers beat the Clippers without Luka Doncic.
• Stephen Curry scored 44 points against Minnesota.
• The World Series is over, and the Houston Astros face a busy free agency.
• England striker Ivan Toney pleaded not guilty to assault, with trial set for June.
